# VARconnection

> A resource hub for K-12 education VARs and resellers covering EdTech trends, school funding, vendor tools, and classroom innovation strategies.

VARconnection, operated by Douglas Stewart Company, serves as a knowledge base for value-added resellers in the K-12 education sector. The site combines vendor resources, product guides, and educational insights to help resellers and educators navigate EdTech adoption, funding opportunities, and emerging classroom technologies.

## Key Topics

- K-12 Education
- EdTech
- VAR Resources
- Douglas Stewart Company
- Deal Registration Portal
- Products Plus
- STEAM Products
- School Funding
- AI in Education
- Educational Technology Trends
- Vendor Programs
- Classroom Strategies
- Early Literacy
- Device Protection
- Digital Citizenship

## VAR Resources & Tools

- [DSC Facts: VAR Resources You Should Check Out](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2024/01/31/dsc-facts-var-resources-you-should-check-out): Guide to Douglas Stewart Company VAR resources including Products Plus and Deal Registration Portal

## K-12 Education Trends & Insights

- [Growing K-12 Trends to Look Out For in 2026](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/01/28/growing-k-12-trends-to-look-out-for-in-2026): Overview of K-12 education trends including AI, AR/VR, and digital citizenship for 2026
- [3 Ways AI has Impacted K-12 Education within the Last Year](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/02/18/3-ways-ai-has-impacted-k-12-education-within-the-last-year): Analysis of AI impact on K-12 education including FERPA and COPPA compliance considerations
- [The Pandemic Effect. What Impacts are Left?](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/03/04/the-pandemic-effect-what-impacts-are-left): Analysis of lingering pandemic effects on K-12 education from sources like Brookings and Education Week

## EdTech Products & Solutions

- [Top Educational EdTech that Saves Teachers Time](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/03/11/top-educational-edtech-that-saves-teachers-time): Review of EdTech tools including NextWaveSTEM, PowerGistics, IPEVO, and I.R.I.S for classroom efficiency
- [5 Top EdTech Schools Fell in Love with in 2025](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/02/11/5-top-edtech-schools-fell-in-love-with-in-2025): Roundup of popular EdTech products including Faraday Defense PhonX3 and TechProtectus device protection

## School Funding & Professional Development

- [3 Ways to get Additional Funding for Schools](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/02/25/3-ways-to-get-additional-funding-for-schools): Guide to school funding options including E-rate, ESSR funds, and Education Savings Accounts
- [Don't Miss these K-12 Educational Conferences in 2026](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/01/21/dont-miss-these-k-12-educational-conferences-in-2026): Calendar of K-12 conferences including TCEA Convention, DLAC, and SXSW EDU in 2026

## Classroom Instruction & Student Success

- [4 Techniques to Improve Foundational Reading Skills](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/03/18/4-techniques-to-improve-foundational-reading-skills): Educational article on early literacy techniques aligned with International Literacy Association standards
- [Surviving Spring Testing Season](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2026/02/04/surviving-spring-testing-season): Student tips for managing test anxiety and stress during spring standardized testing season

## Optional

- [Fun Holiday Teacher Memes for 2025 Winter Break](https://varconnection.dstewart.com/2025/12/10/fun-holiday-teacher-memes-for-2025-winer-break): Holiday humor and memes for teachers from Bored Teachers and We Are Teachers communities
